SELECT rec.id AS recordId, rec.materialid AS materialId, m.sku AS sku, m.name AS materialName, rec.warehouseid AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, rec.formid AS formId, rec.formtype AS formType, ft.name AS formTypeName, rec.operate AS operate, rec.quantity AS quantity, COALESCE(rec.amount_change, 0) AS amountChange, COALESCE(rec.unit_cost, 0) AS unitCost, rec.number AS number, rec.opttime AS operateTime FROM t_erp_inventory_record rec INNER JOIN t_erp_material m ON m.id = rec.materialid AND m.shopid = rec.shopid AND m.isDelete = 0 LEFT JOIN t_erp_warehouse w ON w.id = rec.warehouseid LEFT JOIN t_erp_formtype ft ON ft.id = rec.formtype WHERE rec.shopid = #{shopid} AND rec.id IN
#{id}
